name: List countries
description: Call this when you need the canonical country reference data the Brevo web app uses to populate country and phone-prefix pickers — for example to resolve a country name to its ISO code, its international calling code, or Brevo's internal numeric country_id before filling a form that expects one of those values. This is static reference data served from Brevo's CDN, not account data; for the account's own country or address settings use the organization/account details action instead, and for a contact's country attribute use the contacts actions.

outputs.description: Array of country reference records, one per country or territory.

name.description: English display name of the country or territory, e.g. "Afghanistan".

code.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. "AF". Observed values follow ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, and may be shared by related territories (e.g. Ascension uses "SH").

calling_code.description: International dialling prefix including the leading plus sign, e.g. "+93".

country_id.description: Brevo's internal numeric identifier for the country, used by forms that expect a country id.
